name: Standard Sales Order Creation Route
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order payload satisfying route condition {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}}
expected_outcome: Message enters flow, sets headers and property 'InputPayload', routes through SequenceFlow_82, executes Message Mapping 1, executes Interface_Generic_Headers script, and completes at EndEvent_2
validates: CallActivity_4 header and property enrichment, ExclusiveGateway_80 routing to CallActivity_102, CallActivity_13 header logging execution, EndEvent_2 normal completion

name: Sales Order Return Route
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with Return Sales Order payload satisfying route condition {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}}
expected_outcome: Message routes through SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 (Interface_Generic_Headers script) and successfully completes at EndEvent_9
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 routing to Return path, CallActivity_71 header extraction and custom logging, EndEvent_9 completion

name: Default Routing Escalation
trigger: Inbound SOAP message where neither Sales Order nor SO Return condition matches
expected_outcome: Message falls through ExclusiveGateway_80 default branch SequenceFlow_110 to EndEvent_11 raising EscalationEndEvent with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path execution and EndEvent_11 escalation handling

name: Mapping Failure Triggers Exception Subprocess
trigger: Inbound Sales Order message with invalid schema/content causing Message Mapping 1 to throw an exception
expected_outcome: Flow catches exception in SubProcess_91, CallActivity_97 restores original body from ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 logs original payload as MPL attachment, terminates at EndEvent_95
validates: SubProcess_91 trigger, CallActivity_97 property enrichment restoration, CallActivity_100 attachment logging, EndEvent_95 error termination

name: SOAP Receiver Endpoint Simulation Failure Handling
trigger: Inbound message trigger under outbound network timeout or HTTP 500 error
expected_outcome: Simulated REST receiver participant failure triggers SubProcess_91, properly setting error logs and failing gracefully without unhandled crashes
validates: Resilience against receiver communication faults and verified Exception Subprocess handling
